title: Exit sign
summary: Approve with notes: confirm the items below.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Rated life (L70)
findings.detail: LED estimated useful life of at least 50,000 hours at 70 percent lumen maintenance, from IES LM-80 data.
findings.why_it_matters: Without verified long-term lumen maintenance, we can’t be sure the signs will stay bright enough over time.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Warranty
findings.detail: Warranty Period for LED Luminaires, including LED modules, LED boards, chips, and drivers: Five (5) years from date of Preliminary Acceptance.
findings.why_it_matters: A clear warranty protects us if the LEDs fail early after installation.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: macadam steps
findings.detail: LEDs shall be binned within a maximum 3-step MacAdam Ellipse.
findings.why_it_matters: Consistent color binning ensures all signs look uniform, avoiding noticeable color differences across the building.

findings.title: Different revision found; no quoted values changed
findings.detail: Submitted Rev. 09/05/19, web source Rev. 10/14/25. The revision labels differ; their age order is not confirmed.
findings.why_it_matters: Just having different revision dates doesn’t tell us which document is current, so we rely on the content you submitted.
